title: Profile Pack
description: A label or producer's sound-identity roster: named profiles with the musical anchors (frequency, mode, tempo band, vocal posture) that tools/tag-vibe-profile.mjs scores tracks against. The engine is generic; the pack is where a specific brand's taste lives. Frank's Arcanea pack is the private worked example (FrankX repo); profile-packs/example-profile-pack.json is the public demo.

name.description: Human-readable pack name, e.g. a label name.

version.description: Semver-ish version of the pack contents.

source.description: Optional provenance pointer (canon doc, brand bible) this pack mirrors.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier used in album manifests and scoring output.

archetype.description: Optional role label (e.g. 'Power', 'Clarity') — display only, not scored.

frequencyHz.description: Canonical anchor frequency scored by proximity (50-point axis).

modePreference.description: Preferred modes (e.g. 'Lydian'). Special values 'modal mixture' and 'all modes / modulating' score 22/20 instead of the full 30 — a catch-all preference is a weaker signal than a specific one.

tempoBandBpm.description: [low, high] BPM band (15-point axis, linear falloff to 15 BPM outside). Omit if the profile has no canonical tempo.

voiceTone.description: Vocal/tonal posture keywords; overlap with a track's vocalPosture adds up to 5 points.

palette.description: Visual identity hint for cover art — display only, not scored.
